records.name: A Day in the Life of a Fungi Farmer
records.summary: On Velocia, Takar and Zahra tend bioluminescent fungi in the Ilvani Clan's forest settlement. Their work, their relationship, and the clan's customs unfold beneath the twin suns Enif A and Enif B.
established_facts: The Ilvani Clan lives in a forest settlement on Velocia.
Takar and Zahra are young Saurenai who tend bioluminescent fungi.
The fungi provide sustenance and light for the clan.
Enif A and Enif B illuminate Velocia.

records.name: A World of Death
records.summary: The Saurenai's ancient experiment on Terra, including their introduction of dinosaurs and the devastating asteroid impact, forms part of the history behind their later discovery of intelligent life on the planet.
established_facts: Saurenai scientists seeded Terra with engineered dinosaur life.
The Saurenai hoped the dinosaurs would eventually develop sentience.
Sage Zyrath and Kailen observed the aftermath of the impact.

records.name: Echoes of Stride-Star
records.summary: At a remote Saurenai outpost, Aroth and Pluma detect radio transmissions from Terra, including a shoe advertisement for StrideStar, and prepare to investigate the unexpectedly advanced civilization.
established_facts: Aroth is the lead researcher at a remote Saurenai outpost.
They detect structured radio transmissions originating from Terra.
One intercepted transmission advertises StrideStar footwear.
Aroth and Pluma plan a research mission to Terra.
